mcqs.title: Characteristic feature of the pars nervosa
mcqs.question: The following is a characteristic feature of pars nervosa:

options.A: It is formed of groups of nerve cells separated by fenestrated capillaries.
options.B: It has accumulated neurosecretion called Herring bodies.
options.C: It is formed of follicles of basophilic cells with granular cytoplasm.
options.D: It has an upward extension known as the pars tuberalis.

explanations.A: Incorrect. The pars nervosa contains few or no nerve cell bodies.
explanations.B: Correct. The pars nervosa stores hypothalamic hormones; dilated axon terminals packed with neurosecretory granules are visible as Herring bodies. They store oxytocin or ADH bound to neurophysin.
explanations.C: Incorrect. Follicles of basophilic cells describe glandular adenohypophyseal tissue.
explanations.D: Incorrect. The pars tuberalis is an extension of the pars distalis.

mcqs.title: Stain that identifies mammotrophs
mcqs.question: Mammotrophs could be identified by the following stain:

explanations.A: Incorrect. Silver stains demonstrate reticular fibres.
explanations.B: Incorrect. Orcein is an elastic-fibre stain.
explanations.D: Correct. Mammotrophs are the prolactin-secreting acidophils demonstrated with carmine, which distinguishes them from orange-G-positive somatotrophs. Their number increases during pregnancy and lactation.
